ios.desc:
Introducing Looksee.. an app unlike anything you have ever seen before! Looksee is a visually-driven productivity app to manage your own tasks and to collaborate with your friends & family. It is a unique fusion of social networking and productivity creating a new genre we call “Social Productivity”

Looksee has four modes to cover all possible scenarios of social productivity:

1. BOSS Mode: 
• You are the boss and can delegate tasks to one or many people.
• Simply open the app, frame the task and press the shutter button! 
• Annotate the photos with drawings, stickers & emojis. 
• Or just type a note describing the task.
• Select recipients, specify applicable deadlines and offers. Done! 
• Tasks can be one-time or recurring in nature. 
• Each task has its own private chatroom where you can discuss details and share updates! 
• You can even ask for photo-proof if you really want to make sure it’s done right!

2. MINION Mode: 
• You are the minion and are offering to complete a task in exchange for something. 
• For example, this mode can be used by kids offering to do household chores in exchange for TV time.
• Parents can decide when they get the Looksee if they want to accept the deal or not!

3. ME Mode: 
• Organize your own life and manage your tasks. 
• Tasks can be one-time or recurring in nature. 
• Think of it as a visual reminder; you can take pictures or a video of the task.
• If task is not visual, simply create a note. 
• Also serves as a habit tracker with detailed history view.

4. PRINCESS Mode: 
• You are the princess and are simply conveying your emotions and cravings by taking a cute selfie with one of our beautiful filters!
• There is no work to be done in this mode, it is simply a fun way of expressing yourself and what your heart wishes for! 
• Your wish appears as a thought bubble in your selfie!

Looksee is designed for visual-minded people:
• Typical productivity apps are tedious checklists with dull & text-heavy user interfaces. 
• Looksee steers away from this text-based interface to give you a refreshing visual approach to getting things done!
• Based on the old adage “a picture is worth a thousand words”
• Looksee capitalizes on the ease of taking a photo to convey a thought, emotion or task.
• Task Library allows you quickly track all your tasks with just a glance. 

Price Information: 
Looksee is available for free with most of the features. Advanced features are available to premium subscribers. We offer three subscription

quotes.text:
I am Wasim, Founder of Real Life Apps. I have spent the past 3 years building my startup, team and products. Without a doubt, it has been the most difficult journey of my life. Our mission was to make getting things done as simple as sending a snap or a tweet. To make productivity both cool and social. I believe we have realized this goal. I would be grateful if you take our app for a spin and give us your feedback. The app is named Looksee and is completely free.

Looksee is an innovative Social Productivity app. The app allows people to get things done through a friendly visual presentation rather than old-fashioned “to-do” lists. As a visual person, I was tired of tedious checklists and text-based tools like Notion, Evernote, Todoist etc. That inspired me to create Looksee which uses the power of visuals (photos or video) to capture any task. Looksee enables the user to manage their own tasks, as well as delegate to others in their social circles

Looksee merges two completely different genres of apps, Social Networking and Productivity, into a new breakthrough category of “Social Productivity.”

Here is a 1-minute video that explains Looksee:
https://youtube.com/watch?v=gfBK9L_woH0

Looksee is live on the Apple App Store. Here is a direct link:
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/looksee/id1535769409

We are a small tech startup based in Austin, Texas. As a founder, I am requesting the community's help, advice & feedback!

Thank you so much,

Dr. Wasim Irshad
